---
title: "Testing"
description: "Scan a synthetic document with a test credential to get a known outcome."
---

Use a test credential with the documents below. Each one returns the outcome shown when you open it.

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Driver's license">
    <AccordionGroup>
      <Accordion title="Accepted">
        <Frame caption="T90000001">
          <img src="/images/testing/drivers_license-accepted.png" alt="Accepted" />
        </Frame>
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_ACCEPT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="dldv" type="completed" />
      </Accordion>
      <Accordion title="Expired document">
        <Frame caption="T90000002">
          <img src="/images/testing/drivers_license-expired_document.png" alt="Expired document" />
        </Frame>
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_REJECT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="reason" type="REASON_EXPIRED" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="false" />
      </Accordion>

        <ResponseField name="reason" type="REASON_NOT_OF_AGE" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="false" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="true" />
      </Accordion>
